about: Rebasing a text patch over one applied before it (rule 6): the server's transform_range (server/stilo/modules/sync/model/rebase.py) and the browser's transformTextPatch (app/modules/workspace/model/text-patch.js, moving to app/modules/sync in step 7c-2) both run these. A patch is [start, end) in UTF-16 units; applied is the earlier patch, which replaced [start, end) with `inserted` units. `expect` is the later patch moved over it, or "conflict" when it cannot be placed safely. Ties at the same point keep the later patch before the earlier one's text (the browser's insertAfter=false).
